title: Certification Notices and Reminders — Occupancy and Residency Certification
content:
Under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product, each certification cycle has up to three mailed notices and, where an email address is on file, an email reminder.

## The notice rule

For each cycle the certification request (the **annual request**) is mailed the plan's request lead time — a number of calendar days fixed per plan — before the certification due date, through the plan's request channels, and an email reminder follows the plan's email-reminder lead time before the due date where an email is on file. If the cycle is still incomplete, a **second notice** is mailed the plan's second-notice interval in calendar days after the due date, and a **final notice** the plan's final-notice interval in calendar days after it.

## When notices are mailed

| Profile status | Certification notices |
|---|---|
| pending first certification | mailed |
| current | mailed |
| overdue | mailed |
| absence monitoring (a health-care absence is being monitored) | annual notices replaced by absence check-ins |
| non-occupancy confirmed | none mailed |
| closed | none mailed |

Certification notices are mailed only while the profile status is pending first certification, current or overdue; the status is read from the profile record at the time of mailing. While a health-care absence is being monitored, annual notices are replaced by absence check-ins, as the plan's setting on suspending annual requests provides, and no notice is mailed for a closed profile or one whose non-occupancy is confirmed.

## Once per cycle, and the certification year

Each notice type — annual request, second notice, final notice — is mailed at most once per cycle for a profile. The certification year of every notice and every entry is the calendar year of the cycle's due date, following the plan's certification-year basis. A notice is therefore identified by the profile, the certification year and the notice type together.

## Points of judgement

- *Second and final notices are conditional.* They are mailed only if the cycle is still incomplete when their day arrives; a cycle completed before then receives neither.
- *Same type twice.* Hypothetical case: an annual request has already been mailed for a profile in the certification year of its current due date. A second annual request for that same year is not mailed; a second notice for that year, being a different type, is not barred by the first.
- *Year assignment.* A cycle whose due date falls in January of a hypothetical year carries that year as its certification year, even though its annual request was mailed in December of the preceding year.
